name: Cultural Landscape of Honghe Hani Rice Terraces
description: In southern Yunnan, China, the Hani people have carved thousands of terraces into the slopes of the Ailao Mountains, stepping down to the Hong River. Over about 1,300 years they have channelled water from forested peaks to flood the fields, which also hold ducks, fish and eels beside the red rice. Thatched mushroom-shaped houses dot the 82 villages above the terraces.
